denominator._what_the_denominator_is_of: DEDUPLICATED BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORDS returned by the two free bibliographic sources for the concept block. It is NOT the literature, and it is NOT the registry set of 63 registrations, which is screened separately.

rules.R1: no dapivirine term in title or abstract -> EXCLUDE
rules.R1b: no dapivirine term in title AND no abstract -> UNDECIDABLE
rules.R2: secondary publication type and no trial signal in title -> EXCLUDE
rules.R3b: no trial signal in title AND no abstract -> UNDECIDABLE
rules.R4: trial signal but no vaginal-ring signal -> EXCLUDE
rules.R5a: passes; names an NCT this review pools
rules.R5b: passes; names an NCT the registry search already retrieved -- NOT a miss
rules.R5c: passes; names an NCT the registry search did NOT retrieve -- CANDIDATE MISS
rules.R5d: passes; names no id -- resolve by hand

negative_test.what: Two synthetic records put through the same rules before the real screen runs: one that must be flagged as a candidate search miss, one that must be excluded.
negative_test.controls_are_not_in_the_denominator: The two probes are discarded after scoring. They are not in `ledger` and not in `records_screened`. A control that enters the counted population has stopped being a control.

comparison_sets._why_two: A record naming one of the 63 retrieved registrations is not evidence of a search miss -- the registry search found it. Only a registration OUTSIDE the 63 can be one.
